features.name: Import real data
features.acceptance: Permanent user uploads a validated supported scan bundle; reject unsafe or unsupported data clearly.

features.name: Private projects
features.acceptance: Email OTP sign-in; owner-only files, project list, 3-project quota, resume and delete.

features.name: Hands review workspace
features.acceptance: Seated point-cloud scene; ray select, isolate, frame step, reset, depth views and readable panel.

features.name: Find review candidates
features.acceptance: Three geometry checks: low support, near-duplicate boxes, abrupt dimension change. Explain uncertainty.

features.name: Bounded AI assistant
features.acceptance: Live model calls allowlisted inspection tools; shows measurements, focus and a proposal. Never applies edits.

features.name: Correct or keep a label
features.acceptance: Manual position/size/yaw steps or fit preview; keep with reason, remove confirmed duplicate in current frame, approve/reject; undo supported.

features.name: Save and undo
features.acceptance: Atomic versioned save with audit, last-edit undo, refresh resume, conflict and network recovery.

features.name: Usable export
features.acceptance: Corrected OpenLABEL subset + audit + unchanged point clouds + metadata + hashes; reimport and validate.

features.name: No-signup judge demo
features.acceptance: Real licensed clip with disclosed injected faults; anonymous session, reset; live tools, edits, save and export.

features.name: Release quality
features.acceptance: Clear errors/help/privacy, tested performance/security, real reviewer evidence and truthful submission.
